issues.reason: Standard high-Intelligence bonus languages and one explicit Martial Background weapon choice are supported. The weapon list is limited to the six active Weapon Familiarity proficiencies. Other class-derived weapon options remain pending.
Heritage stat vector and inherited alternate Hatred replacement are modeled; verify alternate ability action triggers/creature-type language with GM before enabling live auto-rules.
All class-specific reward texts and fractional increments are retained, but class-specific targeting and selection-dependent automation require class reconciliation and independent review.
Conditional combat bonuses, grant-versus-feat operations, special racial recovery and some alternate trait effects remain manual until reviewed by a rules engine.

The current runtime test scope covers standard heritage and standard racial traits. Alternate traits, variant heritage mechanics, favored-class rewards and independent full rules review are not enabled by this batch. Conditional combat and Weapon Focus effects remain manual.
